text: Correction to the latest status summary: the existing S624 OpenCAD Studio 2026.40.1 portable build is an additional rights-reviewed, local generic R14 receiver candidate; it passed 90/90 geometry contours and repeat/malformed controls but did not prove apparel semantics.
